quote: Upon a highway designated and signposted for one-way traffic a vehicle shall be driven only in the direction designated.

activation.condition: A vehicle is driven upon a highway designated and signposted for one-way traffic.

obligation.description: Drive only in the direction designated for that one-way highway.

timing.description: Assess direction continuously while the vehicle is driven upon the governed highway.
